question: What comprehensive division of eightfold groups is sought to be fully known?
premises: The division consists of eight groups of eight
Complete knowledge of this division is desired
The knowing is described as endless or thorough
inference: The aim is to fully and thoroughly know the division of the eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: I seek to know fully and thoroughly the division of the eight groups of eight.
